verdict.rationale: While Phaser's input, physics, and animation systems imply an underlying event-driven architecture, the evidence pack never documents a concrete rule/trigger-action mechanism (e.g., event listeners, collision callbacks, or automation hooks) that a user could define to auto-trigger actions on events. Missing for 10: explicit event-emitter/listener API docs, example of binding actions to events (collision, input, timers), and any AI-native automation-rule tooling beyond the MCP agent's freeform code generation.
